items.title: UK trading platform Hargreaves Lansdown ends its crypto holdout
items.summary: Scott Melker discusses how one of the UK's largest investment platforms, Hargreaves Lansdown, is now allowing retail investors to trade bitcoin (BTC-USD) and ether (ETH-USD) products after regulators lifted a ban last year. "The Daily Wolf with Scott Melker" airs every day at 12:00 p.m. Tune in for your daily dose of all things crypto. Make sure to also check out Yahoo Finance's new crypto hub to find the latest crypto-related news.

items.title: Invesco (IVZ) Stock Looks Below Fair Value But Above Fair Value On Sales
items.summary: Invesco stock has logged a very strong 3 year gain while the valuation checks send a mixed signal. The Excess Returns intrinsic value estimate points to upside relative to the current price, while market based multiples suggest the shares are not cheap. Invesco is up 143.1% over 3 years, which puts extra focus on whether the current share price still leaves room for further value creation.
